stable_traits.personality: stubborn, determined, protective of Emond's Fielders

characters.notes: Uses the One Power to create lightning strikes as diversion
Wears a chameleon cloak that blends with surroundings
Associated with Egwene; her presence indicates Egwene is in the Whitecloak camp
Not physically present in this chapter but her presence in the Whitecloak camp is deduced from Bela being there

appearances.whereabouts: In the forest near a Whitecloak encampment, holding horses, then infiltrating the camp to cut picket-ropes
appearances.notable_actions: Holds the horses while Moiraine and Lan scout; infiltrates the Whitecloak camp; cuts multiple picket-ropes to scatter horses; recognizes Bela and realizes Egwene is in the camp; frees Bela and another horse; rides away during Moiraine's lightning diversion
appearances.demeanor: Frustrated at being left with the horses initially; nervous but determined during infiltration; terrified during lightning strikes and wolf appearances

appearances.whereabouts: Scouting the Whitecloak encampment, then on a hillside overlooking it
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the party off the Caemlyn Road to track one of the boys using her coin token; senses when the token is lost and regained; pinpoints the boy's location in the Whitecloak camp; creates a massive lightning diversion to scatter the Whitecloak horses
appearances.demeanor: Calm and focused, though momentarily shaken when the coin token is lost; composed and confident when creating the diversion

appearances.whereabouts: Scouting the Whitecloak encampment, moving through the camp to locate the prisoner
appearances.notable_actions: Scouts the Whitecloak camp; identifies approximately 200 Whitecloaks; locates the imprisoned boy in the center of the camp under guard; devises the plan to cut picket-ropes; warns Nynaeve about wolves; presumably infiltrates to rescue the boy while Nynaeve cuts ropes

appearances.whereabouts: With the party in the forest near the Whitecloak camp
appearances.notable_actions: Allows Nynaeve to hold his reins only because Lan handed them to her; previously bared teeth at her when she reached for his bridle without permission
appearances.demeanor: Wary, potentially dangerous to those not authorized by Lan; battle-ready

appearances.whereabouts: With the party in the forest near the Whitecloak camp
appearances.notable_actions: Pushes her muzzle under Nynaeve's hand; carried Moiraine on the journey

appearances.whereabouts: Tied on a picket-line in the Whitecloak encampment
appearances.notable_actions: Wakes when Nynaeve approaches; accepts Nynaeve's touch and comfort; goes wild during the lightning strikes; carries Nynaeve away from the camp during the chaos
appearances.demeanor: Initially calm and trusting with Nynaeve; panicked during the lightning

appearances.whereabouts: Prisoner in the Whitecloak camp (not directly seen but presence deduced)
appearances.notable_actions: None directly observed; imprisoned with one of the boys

relationships.description: Moiraine is the Aes Sedai who holds Lan's Warder bond; they work together seamlessly in planning and executing the rescue
Reluctant allies; Nynaeve is frustrated with Moiraine's secrecy and imperious manner but works with her to rescue the Emond's Field youths
Working together on the rescue; Lan trusts Nynaeve's competence and she grudgingly respects his skills, though she's competitive with him
Nynaeve is protective of Egwene as a fellow Emond's Fielder and acts to ensure her escape
Lan owns and controls the battle-trained stallion; Mandarb obeys only Lan's authority
Moiraine rides and owns the white mare Aldieb
Bela trusts Nynaeve and accepts her handling even in dangerous circumstances; Nynaeve recognizes and frees Bela
